memos.scout:
I can't make a strong honest case for buying this one, and the brief itself points the other way.

The best-looking signals are weaker than they appear. The curve shows bundle_share 1.0, buyers 1.0, and top3_share 1.0, which means the early supply and buying were concentrated in a few coordinated wallets, not spread across real participants. A launch bot was present, and the top 5 buyers took 61% of post-graduation buys. The 15-minute tape is 439 buyers against 251 sellers, but net flow is only +9.3 SOL on 321 SOL of buying, so most of the new money was matched by selling. The 30-minute return of +5.2x is largely the bundled launch run-up, and a 0.25% drawdown from the high just means it hasn't started falling yet.

The class label says ORGANIC, but the curve metrics contradict that. Organic demand that persists would show buyers spread out and sell pressure fading, not a sell-to-buy ratio of 0.42 right after graduation.

The brief gives no evidence that demand will still be here in 30 to 60 minutes. With a $20 ticket and 1.4 to 5.1% round-trip cost, a bundled coin that is already at 5x and showing heavy distribution is a poor entry. The base rates say skip.
